description.text: The semester begins in early March and ends in June and consists of 16 weeks. Each week students have about 16 hours of Chinese language courses, and 4 hours of Chinese culture classes. Main courses: Elementary Comprehensive Chinese, Elementary Oral Chinese, Basic Chinese and Elementary Chinese Writing. Local visits to places of interest are arranged once or twice each semester.

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language and Culture Program at Chongqing Technology and Business University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1805 USD/per year ￥ 13000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Applicants should be non-Chinese citizen with good health, from 18 to 60 years old who is interested in Chinese..
